seoTitle: CSV to Sitemap Converter (Dates to W3C Format)
metaDescription: Turn a spreadsheet of URLs and dates into a valid sitemap.xml. Map columns, convert dates to W3C format. Free, no upload.
intro: Converts a CSV with a header row into a sitemap and rewrites dates in W3C format.
why:
Many site exports and crawl reports come as CSV. Building a sitemap from them by hand risks bad dates and unescaped characters.

The tool finds the URL, date, changefreq and priority columns by name, or you can name them. Dates like 15/09/2026 or Sep 1 2026 are converted; ambiguous ones follow your day-month choice. Times without a zone are written as UTC.
howTo: Paste the CSV with a header row.
Name the columns if they are not found automatically.
Choose day-month or month-day for dates like 03/04/2026.

faq.a: They are skipped and noted in a comment at the end.
No. Google ignores priority and changefreq.
